avis.texte: I love that it’s an overnight mask. I don’t recommend rotting in bed for longer than 8 hours though because its already fully absorbed by then and will just trap new oils
These mask are amazing. Leaves my skin looking great. My face looks like 10 years younger amazing I told him to recommend it.
By the next morning, my skin felt very soft and looked healthier.

avis.titre: Excellent Hydrogel Masks – Comparable to Premium Korean Skincare
avis.texte: Packaging This set comes with 3 individually wrapped hydrogel sheet masks, packaged securely for freshness. While the presentation feels premium, the downside is that there are only three masks in the box, which makes it pricier compared to many Korean mask sets that typically include more. Texture & Application The hydrogel texture adheres beautifully to the skin without slipping. It feels cooling and soothing from the moment it’s applied, with a comfortable fit that stays in place during the treatment. The serum is lightweight yet nourishing, and there’s no sticky residue afterward. Performance As a 52-year-old with post-menopausal, mature dry skin, I was impressed by how plump, firm, and refreshed my skin looked after just one use. The mask hydrates deeply and gives a noticeable “glass-skin” glow, on par with some of the high-quality Korean hydrogel masks I regularly use. Key Ingredients & Benefits • Peptides – firming and supporting elasticity • Hyaluronic Acid (8 forms) – multi-layer hydration and plumping • Niacinamide (3%) – brightening and evening skin tone • Collagen – helps maintain bounce and smoothness Results Immediately after use, my skin felt hydrated, soothed, and firmer, with a brighter appearance. The glow and moisture lasted well into the next day, making it an excellent mask before a special event or as a weekly skin boost. Overall Impression These hydrogel masks deliver results that truly rival the best Korean skincare masks I’ve tried, offering hydration

Mario Badescu Advanced Collagen Hydrogel Mask is a good quality. My wife and I use these on our self pampering days. The mask adheres nicely to the face. It feels soothing on the skin. I like the light scent. It's not too perfumey. These masks fit all face types. It's flexible. My skin feels soft and supple after use. Leaves me feeling ultra hydrated.

avis.titre: Lovely but I could do without the added fragrance
avis.texte: I enjoyed this mask. It's very comparable to other hydrogel masks I've tried. It came in two parts and both parts were protected with plastic sheet backing. The eye and mouth pieces that were punched out were included. I also made a couple extra cuts in the mask so that it laid more flush to my skin in certain areas. I wore the mask once for about 3 hours. After that amount of time most of it had turned clear except for where pieces overlapped. During the first 5-10 minutes the mask was slippery and I had to adjust some pieces back into place, but that's common. After those first few minutes, it stayed put very well. I could go about my day - eat, talk, whatever. The only thing I don't love is the added fragrance. It doesn't smell bad and it's not strong. It's a light, fruity, citrus scent. I just don't need it. I'd prefer they leave it out. Specifically I'm referring to the oil extracts - Citrus Aurantium Bergamia (Bergamot) Fruit Oil, Linalool, and Limonene. Again, not bad smells by any means, but I could smell it the entire time I was wearing the mask. Aside from the fragrance, I enjoyed this mask and it left my face feeling fresh and plump and glowy for about 24 hours. I will say though that the price is pretty steep at $8 a mask. I think others that are less expensive are just as effective. Made in Korea. No expiration date or shelf life that I could find except that you should use the mask immediately upon opening the pouch. (ingredients list text extracted from photo)

I'm liking the trend of Western brands creating their own versions of hydrogel masks. I thoroughly enjoy using hydrogel masks - unlike sheet masks, which are liquid-soaked, these have a cooling gel consistency that feels amazing on the skin. I like to leave them on for about 30 minutes, or until the mask becomes transparent, which indicates it's fully absorbed (though overnight use is also an option). After use, my skin feels firm, supple, and radiant. I like using these masks as a base before applying makeup; the deep hydration gives my skin a flawless finish.

The Mario Badescu advanced collagen hydrogel masks come in a set of three and feel very cooling and refreshing on the skin. They leave my face soft and hydrated with a nice glow afterward. The fit is a little slippery, so you’ll want to lie back while wearing them. They are definitely on the pricey side, but as an occasional treat they feel indulgent and worth it.

A wonderful set of collagen masks from Mario Badescu. They feature an advanced formula infused with peptides and hyaluronic acid. They are immediately cooling once applied and stay put without sliding around. I find the formula effective after using all three masks. They left my skin SUPER soft and help to re-texturize my skin. All dry patches were gone, and my skin was overall happier. I am happy with this formula and the masks are incredibly comfortable. I RECOMMEND.

I’m only removing a star because I love these masks so much and they’re so expensive at $8 a piece. The hydrogel is extremely comfortable on my sensitive skin vs the majority of the cloth and paper masks. The formula is super moisturizing and gentle. I’m usually a bit reactive to common ingredients in masks like butylene glycol, but this one gave me no issues whatsoever. The mask has decent coverage even on my nose. There is no fragrance and the extra serum made the rest of my skin so soft. I left this on until it dried and didn’t need any extra moisturizer afterwards. I will say that the residue left over would not be good for applying makeup over because there is some pilling after a while. In the morning, may face needed a good cleansing from the residue, but afterwards felt better than it has in a while.

avis.titre: Leaves you skin hydrated and soft
avis.texte: This mask is very hydrating so would be best for those with dry skin. I have normal to oily, and I left this on for about an hour. When I removed the mask, my skin felt a bit sticky, but I did not rinse it. I let it continue to soak in overnight. When I woke this morning, my skin was a bit oily. My skin was hydrated and very soft, though. I do like that this is in two pieces. It makes it much easier to apply and form to your face. I did not put mine in the fridge beforehand, but it still had a bit of a cooling effect.

I really love how soft and plump my skin looks after using these masks. I wore one overnight, and it left my skin feeling hydrated and refreshed by morning. The mask feels cool when first applied, which made me feel a little cold since it’s wet against the skin, but the results were worth it. It can be slippery at first and shifts if you move around, but once it settles it stays in place. One thing to note is the scent. I’m sensitive to smells, and this one was noticeable, which I didn’t care for, but it didn’t bother me enough to stop using it. Overall, a very hydrating mask that left my skin looking and feeling great.

avis.titre: Add lots of hydration and softens while I sleep.
avis.texte: Leaves my skin feeling soft and very hydrated (plumped almost). I wear this at night while I sleep (this will only work if you sleep on your back or it will simply slide off). When you first put this mask on, it feels a bit thick and slippery so it’s best to get it into place and lay flat on your back. As you sleep, the serum is absorbed into the skin, and the mask becomes more translucent and kind of a thinner rubbery feel and as the serum is absorbed into the skin, the mask stays more securely in place. Make sure you use all the extra serum in your package for your neck and arms so you don’t waste any.

avis.titre: Easy to use, light scent, leaves skin feeling soft
avis.texte: I have middle-aged, sensitive skin and these work well with it. It has a light scent to it that smelled citrusy and natural to me, and not cloying. I've used it twice now and the scent does not bother me (and I'm sensitive to scents). I do the 30 minute refresh and there is no way that I could wear it overnight. I try to use the leftover pieces on my chin, but those tend to want to fall off. The mask stays on great though and I like how my skin feels after using it. If they are reasonable in value for three masks, I'll include them in my regular routine.
